GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Took A Sit 3rd 2 Lengths . laid in on Straightening Up , Couldn't Go On # weak when counted

Jumped Ok , trapped 3 Wide No Cover Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, loomed to challenge soon after Straightening Up , bit green last 200m but Kept Coming and held brave second spot, blinkers off again # enormous effort
Blinkers Again Jumped Fast Settled Down Outside Lengths 1 length keen early home turn shared lead 200 laying bumped wknd last 100 # keen/late fade
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Passing the 200m, when laying in, shifted in and bumped a runner. Rider could offer no explanation for the performance of the gelding. Post-race vet exam - no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced keenly in 3rd 2 Lengths . Straightened Up out in Middle Of Track , laid in Under Pressure , had nothing to offer (vet - no visible abnormalities) # found nothing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Vet - NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 800m, worked off fence from the 600m and joined Leaders 3 Wide before the corner, took over Straightening Up and rolled back to fence last 200m, slipped away for Clear win final stages # soft win
Jumped Ok Settled in 4th 6 Lengths . Ridden Along turning for home, Battled On Well enough for 3rd (winner led & bolted in) # ok/winner led

Jumped Ok , sat touch Worse than midfield 3 Wide No Cover 4 Lengths 800m, came Wide fro the corner, laid in a touch last 200m but rider had whip in left hand and he got going late for eye catching placing # ran on strongly
Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths 700m, dropped out in Straight , blinkers off again, cross over noseband off first time # dropped out

Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths 800m, battled on well between runners and was not far off placing, bit lifter off first time, cross over noseband first time, Tongue Tie off first time # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: laid out for a short distance near the 800m. Laid in under pressure in  the straight

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers off, Tongue Tie on) Jumped Ok Settled in 6th 5 Lengths . Ridden Along to go forward on Turn , Straightening Up 3rd or 4th 3 Lengths off. shifted about Under Pressure & was Quickly Battling # couldn't finish off
( Blinkers again) Jumped Ok raced keenly in 3rd 3 Lengths . Hard Ridden @ 500m , Dropped Out # Beaten too soon
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , crossed and led rails 800m, gave kick when challenged Straightening Up , Headed last 300m and weakened, Vet revealed no abnormalities # led/weakened 300m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR the gelding travelled well in the early and middle  stages of the event; however, did not let down when placed under pressure and was disappointing. Vet NVA.
